evidence: The actual workbook row 2 asks for an authentic human voice; the matching Internal Quality Checks row has the same wording and no further annotation. The skill reference asks for sentence variety, contractions, terse notes and a consistent voice. Frozen task/instruction.md:1 opens with "Can you build HireOps into a compensation change desk?" and explains why two funded requisitions need a simultaneous exchange. Lines 3 and 5 describe concrete operator concerns ("without paying anyone twice", "I need the saved old and new figures on screen", "We don't need a dashboard"). Line 9 mixes a precise runtime sentence with "is your call", "don't" and "mustn't", instead of a uniformly polished cadence. The detailed notes preserve that practical voice: task/environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:19-21 says "What keeps catching us out isn't any single screen"; lines 41-42 acknowledge the confusing tier/band numbering; lines 53-55 say "all yours, we don't mind"; lines 199-201 say "There's no save-a-draft-then-raise-it dance to build". The later coordinated-change section (423-480) is more technical because it defines exact financial behavior, but uses direct varied instructions, without marketing gloss or an artificial parallel feature pitch. The integration note retains the frozen template's plain operational register. This is a source-based prose judgment, not a runtime or scoring verdict. The raw evidence index binds the assigned input hash and explicitly states full configured grading/workload/reward and target/Oracle scores are absent; all 114 artifact hashes matched at inspection. Those absent measurements are not needed to decide this prose row and are not waived for other rows.
counterexample: Adversarial scope check: a static compensation dashboard that shows plausible figures but never commits a change could coexist with this naturally worded brief; that would still pass this prose-only row and must earn no functional credit merely because the request sounds human. Conversely, a conforming app using different view names and custom routes is explicitly allowed by instruction.md:5,9 and hireops_rules.md:53-55; its implementation style cannot make the author's voice fail. Treating the precise technical notes or their few tables as proof of robotic prose would falsely fail this otherwise conversational brief. No concrete row-2 false pass or false failure was found.
